description: The official C# binding for Eclipse Cyclone DDS. Including native runtimes, the IDL compiler and automatic C# generation.
Provides a clean and extensible abstraction for implementing caching strategies in ASP.NET Core applications, supporting absolute and sliding expiration, and testable with a built-in fake adapter.
Pixel-exact tile rendering for LoupixDeck plugins: a 5x7 bitmap font, an ARGB framebuffer on the 72x72 content grid and tile building blocks (header, hero value, gauge bar, history chart).
A library that handles experiences for an application. e.g. Quests, Campaigns, Objectives, etc. A generic logic layer for handling most use cases for story narratives and related data tracking.
A SQL Server-based distributed caching extension for .NET applications built on the ArkaSoftware caching abstraction, with automatic cache-table provisioning.
Lightweight marker interfaces for configuring service lifetimes (Transient, Scoped, Singleton) in ASP.NET Core Dependency Injection.
Abstractions for file storage, metadata, and media validation in .NET applications, with storage-mode (physical/database) support and a built-in in-memory fake for testing.
Entity Framework Core save-changes interceptor that captures entity change logs (Insert / Update / Delete) with per-property detail and user context.
SQL Server (Dapper) persistence for entity change logs captured by the ArkaSoftware change-data-log interceptor, with automatic table provisioning.
Entity Framework Core persistence for the Transactional Outbox pattern: outbox DbContext base class, save-changes interceptor, EF repository for the polling publisher, and DI registration.
A background service that polls the outbox table and publishes pending domain events to the message bus.
Message Inbox (idempotent consumer) implementation for the ArkaSoftware message bus abstraction, dispatching received commands and events exactly once.

A YARP-based reverse proxy that exposes models served by other machines (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp and the like) over both the OpenAI and the Anthropic (Claude) protocols, routed by model name, over a pluggable transport.
SQL Server (Dapper) persistence for the Message Inbox pattern, with automatic table provisioning.
RabbitMQ implementation of the ArkaSoftware message bus abstraction (send and receive), fully asynchronous on RabbitMQ.Client 7.x with automatic trace propagation.

Privacy-first analytics for .NET apps and games on desktop, mobile and console. Send named events with an optional number and a few properties and see them in the MightyS Pulse dashboard. No device IDs, optional user id hashed on the device, offline queue on disk. Targets netstandard2.0 and net8.0…
Excel serialization (list-to-workbook, workbook-to-DataTable/list) built on EPPlus 8, implementing the ArkaSoftware excel serializer abstraction with translated headers.
OpenTelemetry registration for ASP.NET Core applications: distributed tracing, metrics, and logs exported over OTLP with ASP.NET Core, HTTP client, runtime, and SQL client instrumentation.
Serilog registration for ASP.NET Core applications: application and user enrichers, exception details, span enrichment, and configuration-driven sinks (Console, File, Seq, MSSQL, Elasticsearch).
Detects runtime software part information (machine, entry assembly, framework, operating system, process, uptime) for logging and observability pipelines.
Declarative C# components, observable state, bindings, and platform-independent view descriptions for .NET 10.
Native WPF host and renderer for SignalNotNoise.UI declarative C# components. Requires Windows and .NET 10.
